pros: Comprehensive suite of marketing tools (email, landing pages, webinars)
Intuitive drag-and-drop email and landing page builder
Robust contact and list management features
cons: Pricing can become expensive, especially for larger contact lists or advanced features
Steep learning curve for advanced automation or specific features
Limited or sometimes clunky integrations with certain third-party tools
Reporting features could be more robust, customizable, or insightful
Platform navigation can be complex with many features nested in menus
Customer support responsiveness or depth of technical assistance
changed: Replaced 'Effective list management and segmentation' with 'Robust contact and list management features' because the notes explicitly detailed the comprehensive grouping of contact-related tools (Lists, Search, Segments, Reports, List hygiene, Suppression lists, Custom fields, Import statistics, Tags) which suggests a more robust system than just 'effective'.

Replaced 'Occasional performance glitches or slow loading times within the platform' with 'Platform navigation can be complex with many features nested in menus' because the note explicitly pointed out the lack of top-level navigation for key features (email, automation) and their placement within a large mega-menu, indicating a structural navigation issue rather than just occasional performance glitches.
